cs.t: Pentel Graph Gear 1000:  https://www.jetpens.com/Pentel-Graph-Gear-1000-Drafting-Penc...  Best mechanical pencil I've ever used. You can tell a lot of thought has been put into every aspect of its design. The Rotring 800 is similarly well-designed, but I prefer the grip of the Pentel.
cs.th: Ask HN: What're the best-designed things you've ever used?

cs.t: Jetstreams are great. Worth pointing out that you can buy refills in various form factors, including Parker style that'll fit the Rotring 600:  https://www.jetpens.com/Uni-SXR-600-Jetstream-Ballpoint-Pen-...  I also recommend the 800 mechanical pencil which has a very satisfying twist-retract tip.
